title: Dealer vs. Private Silver Sales: Premium Comparison
narration: This chart compares the typical premium charged by dealers versus the potential premium achievable through a private sale. Dealers generally add a premium of 5% to 15%, with potential fees like assaying and handling costs adding up to $10 per ounce. Private sales can offer a lower premium of 3% to 7%, but require more effort to find a buyer. The total cost of a dealer transaction can easily exceed the spot price by 10% to 20%.
